full_page.content:
1947, April 24
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original of the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
St. Felix Capuchin Monastery Huntington, Indiana April 24th, 1947
Blessed be God in all His ways!
God bless you Miss Muriel Krausman. I hope you keep well. You've been on my mind for ten days, - wanting acknowledge your favor of Apr. 4th. Well you remember how it was with me when I was up there in January. It is not audiences with callers now but answering letters that is my problem. So please have charity to overlook tardiness, etc.
I thank you just the same and pray for you even though I fail to write. Many thanks again.
Praised be Jesus Christ!
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
